title: DNA: A Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture for Industrial Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2611.20607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-fidelity modeling is fundamental to industrial digital twin, yet a trade-off persists between the physical transparency of mechanistic models and the superior predictive power of data-driven approaches. Existing hybrid methods often fail to bridge this gap, suffering from shallow integration and rigid one-shot modeling strategies that struggle with complex industrial systems. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture (DNA)}. Inspired by the double-helix structure of biological \textit{DNA}, our architecture intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling strands through two novel interaction strategies, forming a symbiotic architecture in which the two strands mutually enhance predictive capability. translated_title: DNA：一种面向工业数字孪生的双螺旋层次化深度交互网络架构
translated_abstract: 高保真建模是工业数字孪生的基础，然而机理模型的物理透明性与数据驱动方法的强大预测能力之间始终存在权衡。现有的混合方法往往无法弥合这一差距，存在集成浅层化和僵硬的一次性建模策略等问题，难以应对复杂的工业系统。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种双螺旋层次化深度交互网络架构。受生物DNA双螺旋结构的启发，我们的架构通过两种新颖的交互策略将机理建模与数据驱动建模两条“链”交织在一起，形成一种两条链相互增强预测能力的共生架构。此外，DNA的层次化结构使其能够通过两个量身定制的深度学习框架，以多阶段方式对复杂系统进行建模。我们评估了……
tldr: 受生物DNA双螺旋结构启发，该论文提出双螺旋层次化深度交互网络架构，通过两种新颖的交互策略将机理建模与数据驱动建模深度交织、相互增强，并借助层次化多阶段建模提升复杂工业数字孪生系统的预测能力。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the biological DNA double-helix structure, this paper proposes a Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture that intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling through two novel interaction strategies, using hierarchical multi-stage modeling to enhance prediction for complex industrial digital twins.
